evidence.finding: Confirms Ceratotherium simum; not a measured anatomical model
Mentions Amadou and Tayo; no claim that downloaded generic model reproduces either individual
1057m2 indoor and 3621m2 outdoor describe shared rhino-zebra complex, not exhibit16 alone

Modelling reference: wide lip, low head carriage, neck hump and three toes distinguish white rhino. Soft varied substrate, shallow muddy resting space and shade inform the visual scene. Behaviour should include grazing and resting. These guidelines do not establish the real Bursa enclosure layout. Original document linked, not redistributed.

performanceDecisions.textures: Two shared1K animal maps; 512px ground/rock/wood derivatives and shared CC0 tree maps. Nominal animal RGBA mip estimate10.67MiB is not total GPU memory.
performanceDecisions.animation: Near target60Hz desktop/30Hz small viewport,far12Hz; offscreen skeletons and hidden documents freeze; dt capped80ms
performanceDecisions.runtimeGeometry: Offline513x17 walk/idle contact table; bilinear scalar lookup at runtime, no CPU skinned vertex loop
performanceDecisions.rendering: No physics engine,new reflection pass,fur particles,high-density grass or extra full-screen effects
performanceDecisions.acceptance: Target smooth30Hz phone and60Hz desktop with existing atlas overhead measured before integration; browser viewport simulation is not a phone benchmark
performanceDecisions.targetsAre: Engineering targets for this project,not numerical mandates in the cited documentation
